Dataset contains 2,146 total applications. Non-Hispanic Black/African American males aged 35-44 appear in 15 cases: 12 loans originated (80% approval) vs 3 denied (20% rejection). Analysis of the data shows no systematic discrimination against non-Hispanic Black or African American males age 35-44. This approval rate is comparable to or higher than the overall approval rate across all demographics in the dataset.
